title: Humraaz (2002)
desc: Karan schemes to cheat Raj by marrying Priya to him for wealth, but Priya genuinely loves Raj and leaves Karan. Enraged, Karan seeks revenge to reclaim everything.

title: Bhoothnath
desc: Banku, his mother, Anjali Sharma, and her father move into Nath Villa, unaware of a ghost. A friendship forms; Banku helps ghost seek salvation.

title: Akhiyon Se Goli Maare
desc: A gangster wants his daughter to wed the biggest goon in town. She plays a trick which seems to work, but what if all is revealed?

title: Khuddar
desc: An honest man turns to crime to support his family, but guilt and tragedy haunt his journey. Can he redeem himself before it's too late, or will his past forever define his future?

title: Mard
desc: King Azad's son battles British general Dyer to rescue his imprisoned father.

title: Bal Ganesh And The Pomjom Planet IV
desc: When Mooshak and friends are captured on planet Pomzom, Bal Ganesh rises to the challenge, using his wit and courage to embark on a daring mission and save the day.

title: Maa Beti
desc: A heartfelt emotional drama highlighting the bond between mother and daughter, exploring sacrifice, love and family relationships.

title: Vardi
desc: Bhagwan Singh is killed saving Inspector Verma from Lalchand. Years later, his son and Police Commissioner Verma swear to apprehend Lalchand.

title: Ghar Ghar Ki Kahani
desc: Ram suspects his wife of an affair with his younger brother Amar. Even after Amar marries his true love, Ram's doubts persist, straining bonds and fueling mistrust.

title: Muqaddar Ka Faisla
desc: A priest is falsely accused, imprisoned, and his family falls into ruin. After release, homeless and broke, he embarks on a quest to seek revenge on those who betrayed him.

title: Bal Ganesh And Friends From Zeba V
desc: Devotees Topi, Dhoti, and Suit-Boot journey to planet Zeba with Bal Ganesh tales, sharing stories with friends in a gentle, adventurous celebration of devotion worldwide.

title: Krishna Cottage
desc: A partially written book with nine-and-a-half stories turns out to be cursed, threatening several college friends when one of them reads it, triggering dangerous consequences.

title: Ghar Dwaar
desc: A family saga explores strained relationships generational conflicts and reconciliation as members fight to protect their home and honor.
